_readme: AGENT-AUTHORED PROPOSAL (P03, prompt-pack). Every lot is PROPOSED; nothing here is a decision or an approval. Owner, canary site, dates, thresholds and rollback-trigger values are deliberately absent — they are human fields (docs/ops/flag-decisions.json). Validated and rendered by node tools/agent/switch-lots.js (--check in tests/switch-lots.test.js).

expiry._note: N is the owner's to set (prompt-pack P03 step 7). While null the expiry test is not armed and says so; the pure check is unit-tested with fixtures.

lots.title: Daily work journey
lots.profiles: Every signed-in person (site coordinators, site IT, technicians, managers); data stewards for the data-quality board
lots.changes: Workspace profiles and settings page; Home shows one queue of the person's own work, per-block states, an 'Awaiting me' list; commitments become a register; role landing page; menu active entry from the address and site carried in links; data-quality board for the admin tier; feedback button.
lots.risk: low-medium (AI estimate): presentation and read-only queues; every reader keeps its own site check. commitments_enabled opens a new write surface (commitments register).
lots.metric_candidate: value-scoreboard: share of pilot users opening Home ▸ My work weekly; first-click success (FIRST-CLICK-PROTOCOL) on the daily tasks

lots.title: PMO journey — portfolio and project reading
lots.profiles: PMO, project managers, committee members, site editors reading their site's projects
lots.changes: Portfolio scoped to the reader's sites, list/board views, 'My projects' default, named project team and project roles, RACI per task, RAID log, composite project RAG, on-demand project report, Simplified/Expert switch.
lots.risk: medium (AI estimate): portfolio_site_scope_reads changes who reads which project (narrows reads to own sites); project roles feed capability checks.
lots.metric_candidate: share of active projects with a named team and an up-to-date RAG at the monthly committee

lots.title: PMO journey — change control, baselines and gates
lots.profiles: PMO, committee, project managers; site editors (plan writes)
lots.changes: Baseline written at approval, committee re-baseline, change requests (with simulation), gate checklists, MS-Project-style baseline slots, DCMA schedule check, templates; editors of the project's site may write plans.
lots.risk: HIGH (AI estimate): portfolio_editor_plan_writes WIDENS write access (site editors write plans that only the committee writes today) — STOP-AND-REPORT, access-policy owner decision required.
lots.metric_candidate: share of schedule changes going through a change request; number of re-baselines per project per quarter

lots.title: PMO journey — scheduling, resources and collaboration
lots.profiles: PMO, schedulers, project managers, project teams
lots.changes: Task scheduling editor (modes, constraints, link types), interactive Gantt, calendars, resource pool and levelling proposals, team-load (capacity) view, board view, Now/Next/Later roadmap, append-only comments with in-app mentions.
lots.risk: medium (AI estimate): interactive Gantt writes through the existing task route and plan-write guard; capacity meaning undefined until CAPACITY-DATA-CONTRACT is signed.
lots.metric_candidate: share of pilot projects with a dependency-linked schedule; levelling proposals accepted vs rejected

lots.title: PMO journey — time, money and benefits
lots.profiles: PMO, Finance controller, finance-viewer, benefit owners, CIO (annual pack)
lots.changes: Time entries and timesheet approval, earned value, budget periods, actuals FILE import (dry run first), mandatory currency, finance certification by a named verifier, benefit value classes and benefit owners as users, annual planning pack (draft).
lots.risk: HIGH (AI estimate): money surfaces — money stays admin tier + finance-viewer; certification must never be shown without a named verifier; actuals import is a manual file, never a Pronto connector (boundary).
lots.metric_candidate: share of projects with actuals reconciled to budget periods each month; certified vs uncertified money tiles

lots.title: PMO journey — optional plan exchange (extras)
lots.profiles: PMO and project teams that plan in an external tool; IT admin (credentials)
lots.changes: MSPDI XML and P6 XER exchange, .mpp import through a locally installed converter, read-only Jira / Azure DevOps pulls, offline task edits queued on the project page.
lots.risk: medium (AI estimate): optional extras only (boundary 2026-11-12: the native tool must stay fully usable alone); Jira/AzDO need credentials (human); offline edits need a field test.
lots.metric_candidate: number of plans exchanged without manual re-keying; offline queue items stuck (should be zero)

lots.title: Roadmap publication and portfolio sensitivity
lots.profiles: Service & Support Manager, PMO publication owner, committee, exec readers of the monthly pack, incubation coordinators
lots.changes: Publish Roadmap Manager into the portfolio (dry run → apply → parity), audience snapshots with optional public link (never amounts), soft delete with two-person rule for portfolio nodes, sensitive projects, portfolio slide in the exec pack, incubation-born RFIs in the queue.
lots.risk: medium (AI estimate): public share link for site/programme snapshots (never amounts — to verify in the lot run); soft delete is the rollback of a publication.
lots.metric_candidate: roadmap parity checks clean after publication; snapshots published per audience

lots.title: Governance cadence — decisions, reviews, handovers
lots.profiles: Governance committee chair, committee members, site managers, incident and problem owners, site IT leads (shifts)
lots.changes: Decision lifecycle and mandatory motive, site obligations count decisions, draft Monday agendas (nothing sent), controls register (candidates), post-incident reviews, problem candidates, handoffs register, shift handover, A01 escalation of commitments without a due date.
lots.risk: medium (AI estimate): new mandatory fields change daily gestures; nothing is sent (handoff notifications stay dark in the keep list).
lots.metric_candidate: share of committee decisions with owner + due date + motive; handoffs accepted within the shift

lots.title: KPI trust — read-only explanations on dashboards
lots.changes: Base population line, sample-size warnings (only once a min_sample is adopted), definition drawer, metric explanation, small multiples, shareable URL filters, human-entered chart notes with a source, red-tile → action links (needs commitments), value scoreboard, translated pages.
lots.risk: low (AI estimate): display only, no figure the server did not send; nothing is certified by showing a definition.
lots.metric_candidate: drill/definition-drawer opens per week; questions to the KPI committee about 'what does this number mean'

lots.title: Reporting rhythm — reminders, drift and deck clarity
lots.profiles: Site coordinators, Service & Support Manager, reporting owner, admins, HR/department heads (roll-up)
lots.changes: Report drift banner, 'Other (n)' bucket on deck charts, alert digest grouped by rule, in-app schedule reminders, weekly-report nudges, action-ageing reminders, connector health page, department roll-up.
lots.risk: low-medium (AI estimate): in-app only; deck output changes (golden fingerprint expected to move for exec_deck_other_bucket).
lots.metric_candidate: weekly reports submitted on time (WEEKLY-REPORT-STOPWATCH); overdue site actions

lots.title: Site operations evidence — inspections, field, assets, WAN
lots.profiles: Inspection owner, technicians (field app), Finance, Network owner
lots.changes: Repeat findings, independent verification of Critical/High corrective actions, field review step and task timing baseline, certified asset-money display, WAN SLA contract evidence required, WAN SLA claims register.
lots.risk: medium (AI estimate): money display (admin tier + finance-viewer only); claims e-mail never leaves while the WAN notify arm is dark.
lots.metric_candidate: share of Critical/High actions independently verified; field form time per task (baseline only)

lots.title: Access security hardening
lots.profiles: Security owner, super_admins, every account (sign-in), direction (executive read-only), data owner (exports)
lots.changes: Per-account sign-in throttle and failures-only limiter, nightly grant expiry, approval before a grant, emergency access, break-glass time box, recertification campaign (answers recorded only), executive read-only portfolio, strict export policy and watermark.
lots.risk: HIGH (AI estimate): can lock people out (throttle, approvals, read-only direction); break-glass must stay possible.
lots.metric_candidate: expired grants ended per night; sign-in lock-outs reported to the helpdesk

lots.title: Operations resilience — sync drift, delivery failures, restore, identity
lots.profiles: Platform/ops owner, data owners per flow, Information Security, data owner (site codes)
lots.changes: Drift alerts through the existing sync alert path, delivery-failure alerts, full restore drill (TEST instance), Entra deprovisioning DRY RUN, controlled 409 on shared site codes. Policy control center (one page over the existing rule stores; high-risk changes need a second super_admin).
lots.risk: medium (AI estimate): alerts use the already-armed sync alert path (recipients needed); site_code_shared_block refuses saves until the data owner fixes shared codes.
lots.metric_candidate: sync drift alerts acknowledged; restore drill RTO measured (no threshold set here)

lots.title: PMO journey — portfolio intake register, data quality, register and executive dashboard, decision agenda and management alerts, lifecycle / review / audit (portfolio spec Lots 1–5)
lots.order_note: New lot (portfolio reconstruction spec, Lots 1 and 2). Arm ppm_intake_register_enabled first; then ppm_data_quality_enabled (shadow) for a shadow period; ppm_dq_gate_enforced last, only after the PMO has approved the required set and the blocking checks. Lot 3: ppm_portfolio_dashboard_v2_enabled (read-only register + executive dashboard) after ppm_intake_register_enabled (and ppm_data_quality_enabled for the DQ card); its report definitions (unfunded, without owners, high risk, stalled 90 days) are PROPOSED. Lot 5: ppm_field_audit_enabled first (low risk, one ledger row per changed project field + created_by / updated_by, recommended early); ppm_extended_lifecycle_enabled (idea · assessment · handover · benefits_review, exits deferred / rejected / cancelled — turning it back off leaves projects in an extended stage unable to move); ppm_review_workflow_enabled (four-eyes: assign reviewer, request information, return for correction, self-approval refused fail closed) after ppm_field_audit_enabled; ppm_business_case_freeze_enabled last (409 on approved business-case fields without an approved change request — needs ppm_change_requests_enabled to be usable). Lifecycle stages, review steps, frozen fields and the role mapping are PROPOSED. Lot 4: ppm_decision_agenda_enabled (decision agenda, project-linked decisions in the existing DEC register) after ppm_intake_register_enabled; ppm_alert_actions_enabled (six management alerts, promotion to a commitment, in-app only) after it; ppm_alert_decision_age_days stays blank (off) until the PMO sets a bottleneck age. Alert rules, severities, recommended actions and the outcome list are PROPOSED.
lots.profiles: PMO, committee members (who maintain projects), admin tier (reference lists), every project reader
lots.changes: Projects carry the intake fields (type, tags, priority, structured business need, expected value, delivery lead, indicative quarter + schedule confidence, budget status / approval date / reference, decision required, delivery effort, risk exposure, FTE, skills, workload notes, explicit TBC / not applicable / none-known states); new projects get an immutable PRJ-YYYY-NNN id; the admin tier maintains the reference lists; Intake tab with field guidance on the project page. Existing projects get ids only through tools/ppm/backfill-project-ids.js (dry run first). Lot 2: data-quality score per project and per site (Σ completed ÷ Σ required), blocking errors, the 16-item submission checklist (shadow); optional refusal of the proposal → approval move on a blocking error (invalid schedule, no IT owner). Lot 3: /portfolio-register.html — register table (search, multi-filter, sort, columns, views saved in the URL, frozen ID / site / name), five KPI cards with drill-through, site / priority / status / risk / per-currency budget analyses, monthly active load, standard reports, CSV / Excel exports keeping the filters (amounts only for amount readers). Lot 5: extended lifecycle stages behind the existing gates (sponsor ≠ decider added, every exit / return needs a reason, status still follows the stage); review actions on the Gates tab; decisions out of approval and approval sign-offs refused to the requester, the owner, the sponsor and an approver not independent of the requester; every changed project field kept in the ledger with old / new value; approved business-case fields frozen behind a change request. Lot 4: /portfolio-decisions.html — decision agenda (projects with decision required yes / tbc, their linked decisions with authority, due date, outcome and decision date; required-but-not-recorded first), the committee records decisions about projects; six management alerts (critical / high risk, unfunded for amount readers, decision bottleneck, missing delivery lead, schedule error) that the committee assigns by promoting them to a commitment (one per alert, escalation matrix, verified closure). Nothing is sent.
lots.risk: low-medium (AI estimate): additive columns, writes stay committee-only; the priority meanings, risk levels and effort bands are PROPOSED reference data the PMO must review before arming; the id backfill is permanent (ids are never reused).
lots.metric_candidate: share of live projects with type, priority, business need, sponsor, IT owner and budget status filled; projects without an id after the backfill (should be zero)

lots.title: Adoption Lot B — each profile lands on its job
lots.order_note: Adoption review 2026-11-20, Lot B. Enable per pilot site together with ui_role_landing and ui_i18n_pages (pilot owner); gate = the human first-click and SUS sessions of USABILITY-TEST-PROTOCOL.md on two pilot sites.
lots.profiles: Committee / PMO, finance readers, auditors, KPI committee, dashboard publishers, scorecard readers, field technicians (landing); executives and site-less admins (Home group card); the admin tier (source freshness on Home); site coordinators and readers (Helpdesk on their site)
lots.changes: Feature-role accounts land on the first page of their workspace profile instead of the Helpdesk; Home for a person with no site shows a group card (worst sites when the role reads the Vue Groupe grid, late projects, decisions due); Home for the admin tier lists the last collection of each data source; the Helpdesk opens on the person's own site for site-scoped roles.
lots.risk: low (AI estimate): presentation only — every page and route keeps its own gate (walked per persona by tests/adoption-lota-nav-authz.test.js); no new route, no write.
lots.metric_candidate: first-click success per profile (FIRST-CLICK-SHEET); median clicks from login to the profile's value page; page_viewed of the landing page by profile

lots.title: Portfolio phase 2 — structured dependencies & risks, resource demand & capacity, documents, effort scoring, scenarios, BI (portfolio spec Lot 6)
lots.order_note: Portfolio reconstruction spec Lot 6 (Phase 2), after L14 (ppm_intake_register_enabled first for the declared effort / risk fields). Arm one switch at a time, each after a PMO shadow review: ppm_structured_dependencies_enabled, then (optionally) run tools/ppm/backfill-project-dependencies.js as a dry run; ppm_resource_demand_enabled with ppm_capacity_fte set by the resource owner (unset = capacity unknown, no colour); ppm_effort_scoring_enabled; ppm_documents_enabled only after the operator has decided storage / retention / malware scanning; ppm_scenarios_enabled (read-only); ext_api_portfolio_enabled last — data owner + security decision, and an API consumer key with the portfolio:read scope.
lots.profiles: PMO, committee members, project editors under the plan-write rule, resource owners (capacity), every project reader (read views), BI consumers (external API keys with portfolio:read)
lots.changes: Project page: Dependencies tab (on another project or an external category; owner, status, target date, criticality; loops refused; flags) with risk exposure (4 PROPOSED levels, residual, due date, rollup); Resources tab (demand lines per skill, numeric FTE, monthly load vs capacity, effort score of seven factors); Documents tab (typed, versioned, content-checked, ≤ 10 MB, money documents restricted). /portfolio-phase2.html: monthly load vs capacity, exposure by project, cross-project loops / flags, effort scores, read-only scenario. External API: /ext/v1/portfolio/* and OData Portfolio* (non-sensitive projects, no amount, no person name).
lots.risk: low-medium (AI estimate): additive tables (migration 130), every write under the existing plan-write rule and in the ledger; capacity thresholds, exposure mapping, effort weights / bands and the document allow-list are PROPOSED; document storage has no malware scanning (operator decision); the external API exports project names and dates to a third-party tool.
lots.metric_candidate: share of active projects with at least one structured dependency or 'none known'; months over capacity per skill; external dependencies without an owner (should trend to zero); projects with a full effort score

armed_in_production.reason: Outbound send. The code default is dark but CLAUDE.md (2026-09-23) records it ARMED in production; the owner must record a keep decision for the production value — not a lot activation.

outbound.reason: Sends something outside the server (e-mail, Teams, webhook, scheduled publication, source-system write). Stays dark until a reviewed recipient list, a dry run and the notifications_stop test (alert_external_enabled prerequisite) — a separate outbound decision, not a journey lot.

source_system_write.reason: Writes to ServiceDesk Plus. Boundary: source systems are read-only. Keep dark; any activation is a CAB/owner decision outside this plan.

kill_switch.reason: Emergency stop for every notification; dark is its correct resting state.

not_a_switch.reason: A setting or a recorded fact, not a behaviour switch — the register counts it as dark only because its default is '0'. PROPOSED: exclude it from the dark list in tools/agent/flag-register.js (reclassification; no code removal).

irreversible_or_destructive.reason: Deletes, revokes or migrates one way; keep dark until the named prerequisite has run on TEST and the owner decides.

committee_policy.reason: Changes a published number or an official policy; needs an adopted committee decision (DEC/D-xx) first — not an activation lot.

external_precondition.reason: Waits for a fact that does not exist yet (privacy notice, HSE evidence, non-UTC site, AI provider, real-device field sessions, installer E2E on TEST).

live_by_default.reason: Shipped ON: the default '1' is today's behaviour (a safety guard, an operator alert, a policy that predates the switch, or a compatibility mode awaiting its own decision). Listed so that no switch ships ON without a recorded classification (P11 R3-A2). Turning one OFF is a decision of its owner (FLAG-REGISTER owner column), not of this plan.

live_setting_not_a_switch.reason: A numeric setting whose value happens to be 1 (OpManager REST concurrency), not a behaviour switch. Kept so the live-switch check (P11 R3-A2) does not flag it; changing it is a tuning decision of the platform owner.

retire.reason: Pseudo-switch for a frozen deployment lot. The sibling repository's CLAUDE.md (step 5, DEC-4, 2026-10-22) records the tracker freeze as RELEASED and the files shipped by hand. If the owner confirms production carries commit 437a80f, the entry is dead.
retire.remove: the FROZEN_FALLBACK entry in tools/agent/flag-register.js (no product code)

retire.reason: Same release as above (commit b681083, App.jsx).
retire.remove: the FROZEN_FALLBACK entry in tools/agent/flag-register.js (no product code)

retire.reason: Superseded by opmanager_ca_bundle (the client logs a warning telling the operator to paste the CA bundle and set it back to 0). Turning it on disables TLS verification; it has no place in an activation lot.
retire.remove: the key in services/reportConfig.js DEFAULTS, the tlsInsecure branch in services/opmanagerClient.js and the admin field — only after the owner confirms production value is 0 and a CA bundle is pasted
